topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: Ran a lot of miles on the pavement today, chasing shadows and cold trails. Came home to find a bouquet on the step, no card, just a ribbon. Kinda haphazard, not some florist's fancy arrangement. Maybe from a corner shop, or picked wild from the edge of the city limits. Doesn't matter, really. Smelled like late spring, though it's still winter. Put 'em in a vase, watched the water turn a little murky with the earth on the stems. Noticed the light was starting to fade, thought about how it'd be nice to have someone to share the quiet with. Not a bad day, all things considered.
